integrity: The all-orders result is proved analytically by reducing the strong odd condition to odd multiplicities in the center neighborhood and using the perfect-matching criterion for complete multipartite graphs. Exhaustive canonical-partition enumeration for k=2 through 5 is a stress test only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to friendship graphs with at least two triangles. A recent linear-time algorithm computes an optimal strong odd coloring for arbitrary block graphs, so the new contribution claimed here is the exact feasible color-count spectrum and structural parity characterization, not general minimum-value computability.
title: Strong-odd color-count spectrum of friendship graphs
